class.name: Biome
class.brief_description: A list of [PlantSpecies] in priority order, placed by a [VegetationField3D].
class.description: The species of one kind of landscape (a meadow, a conifer forest, a swamp). [VegetationField3D] places them in order: earlier species first, later ones keeping clear of their [member PlantSpecies.footprint], so list trees before bushes and bushes before ground cover.

members.member: The species, in the order they are placed.
